## Summary

Describe what this PR changes and why. Link the issue it closes (e.g. `Closes #12`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / chore
- [ ] Build / CI / packaging

## Verification

Confirm all gates were run on the final commit:

- [ ] `npm run lint` (zero warnings)
- [ ] `npm test` (89+ tests pass)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Manual check in the browser and/or the desktop app (state which)

## Notes for reviewers

Anything risky, intentionally out of scope, or worth a second look (theme tokens, motion and
`prefers-reduced-motion`, auth/role isolation, scoring math, packaging config).
